_comment: 24 experiments across 4 branches. Entries are GROUPED BY BRANCH so the run
performs the minimum number of checkouts (4 groups -> 3 actual switches,
since the run starts on the main branch). Within a group every entry
still names its Branch: switchBranch() early-returns on 'already on branch',
and preflight validates a no-Branch entry against the CURRENT working tree,
which would fail for any config that lives only on another branch.
q3 is special: its target operator is a join, so the baselines must run on
koala_q3 and its DRRS run on drrs_q3. Those two groups
are placed back-to-back so q3's four bars are measured close together in
time, at no extra checkout cost.
All 24 configs report the QueryName the figure scripts expect, so results
_Remote / _DRRS. Repeated keywords never collide across queries.
